hypotheses.Q0_native_channel_ce_sum_is_exact: All 4,608 channel contributions reconstruct exact CE directional derivatives with relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.Q1_static_512_channels_are_loss_sufficie: A discovery-frozen 512-channel bank retains at least 0.90 CE derivative fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q2_static_1024_channels_are_high_fidelit: A frozen 1,024-channel bank retains at least 0.95 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q3_ranked_channels_beat_random: At 512 channels, the frozen bank exceeds the random-bank 95th percentile by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.Q4_native_loss_neuron_sparsity_is_suffic: Every corpus reaches 90% CE derivative fidelity with at most 512 channels.
hypotheses.Q5_static_loss_bank_transfers_ood: At 512 channels, each OOD fidelity is within 0.05 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.Q6_context_specific_channel_selection_is: A marginal per-example 512-channel oracle exceeds the static bank by at least 0.05 on at least one corpus.
hypotheses.Q7_loss_is_sparser_than_local_operator_e: Every corpus reaches 90% CE fidelity with at most 1,024 channels, versus 2,048 for Layer-16 local operator energy.
hypotheses.Q8_full_native_bank_has_unit_fidelity: All 4,608 channels retain at least 0.999999 fidelity on every corpus.
